en: A black‑and‑white panoramic harbor view showing waterfront buildings, boats and small sailing yachts in a marina, with a prominent tower on the right and a pavilion-like structure near the water in the center. Trees and rooftops occupy the foreground. In the lower left corner, white printed text reads "Helsinki / Helsingfors," and a small number "2726" appears in the lower right corner.
